items.title: Trevor Lawrence: Launches four TDs in London loss
items.description:
Lawrence completed 24 of 41 passes for 306 yards and four touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.

items.title: Bhayshul Tuten: Two receiving TDs in Week 6 loss
items.description:
Tuten carried the ball 12 times for 39 yards and caught all four of his targets for 48 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Texans.

items.description:
